listing.name: Super Metroid Recompiled
listing.summary: Native Super Metroid recompilation with an exact original and pinned Windows runtime.

steps.title: Keep the original and older installation separate
steps.instruction: Use your own exact unchanged headerless Super Metroid (Japan, USA) original, SHA-256 12b77c4bc9c1832cee8881244659065ee1d84c70c3d29e6eaf92e6798cc2ca72. Keep it unchanged outside the new player folder and put a matching copy named game.sfc inside. Headered, modified or other-region inputs are different. No original is supplied or downloaded. Upstream recognizes its input; registration does not authenticate the original or package. Preserve every older runtime with all its data.

steps.title: Prepare the separate upstream player
steps.instruction: Open the linked v0.4.2 release and extract its official Windows x64 ZIP into a new writable folder. Keep SuperMetroidSNESRecomp.exe, all assets, packaged configuration, built-in mod manifests, notices and companions together in supermetroid-0.4.2-windows-x64. Use shipped defaults without old settings, states, mods, donor assets or developer/path overrides. Complete upstream setup deliberately, then register SuperMetroidSNESRecomp.exe with its containing folder as working directory and two literal argument lines: --rom then game.sfc. Do not select replay_diagnostic.py or any build/setup helper as the player.

steps.title: Choose Play and preserve the whole copy
steps.instruction: You and upstream own this external runtime and data. Play is explicit; removing registration preserves its external files. Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are unavailable. Settings changes can restart into a successor game process while the initially registered process exits. Portcove completion does not prove all copies stopped. Close every game window/process before copying or replacing any runtime or player data. A Portcove library containing any managed installation of this identity cannot also attach this external copy. Keep the managed installation and use the upstream copy directly, or register only in a separate library with no managed installation, other registration or pending launch for this identity. Do not remove an older runtime or kept data to enable registration.

warnings: This guide applies only to the inspected v0.4.2 Windows package. The older managed pin and its exact creating contract remain unchanged. The new package is not a managed update or Supported/gameplay acceptance.

Keep the whole fresh folder, original copy, SRAM, states, configuration, screenshots, mods state and logs/replay sidecars together. Do not import old data, point --config at old data or share data folders. States are build-specific; unchanged source bytes do not establish compatible progress or host snapshots.

Default diagnostic recording contains game memory, inputs, build/original identities, settings and potentially private local paths. Nothing uploads automatically. Share only deliberately; keep replay sidecars together. Read-only fallback logs under %TEMP% are outside this folder. SM_REPLAY_RECORD=0 is an optional user opt-out.

Keep config.local.ini absent, developer/oracle/trace and custom-path overrides disabled, and packaged PolyForm Noncommercial and dependency notices intact. No game original or donor game artwork is supplied; extra mods, donor inputs and Generate & rebuild need separate qualification.

Fresh upstream Widescreen/Fit and forty configurable features do not prove full-game fidelity. The optional Zero Mission map-art picker needs your separately owned matching original; leave that donor route unused here.

source_requirements.label: Super Metroid (Japan, USA) exact headerless SNES original

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide the exact unchanged headerless original. Portcove keeps a SHA256-checked game.sfc copy beside the runtime; backups include that ROM copy. Host save states require the same runtime build; preserve guest SRAM before considering upgrades. Keep config.local.ini absent and developer trace, capture and path overrides disabled. Keep packaged executables, libraries, assets, notices and built-in mod manifests unchanged. Extra mods and donor assets need separate qualification. Preserve upstream PolyForm Noncommercial and dependency notices; original game data is not included. This managed route stays on its accepted build to keep build-specific quickstates usable. Keep that creating version for those states. A newer upstream copy follows its own setup and save instructions; changing runtime versions does not rewind progress or establish quickstate compatibility.

release_maintenance.reason: The inspected v0.4.2 Windows package can spawn a successor on settings changes and exit; Core does not currently track that full lifetime. Keep the accepted managed pin and its retained player-data contract. The separate upstream-owned player guide does not replace them.
release_maintenance.reconsider_when: Reassess managed creation only when a supported tracked handoff or upstream process-lifetime contract keeps supervision valid through settings changes, and exact package/source, all data writers and old/new state boundaries are qualified. Preserve existing native, populated-data and protected-client holds.
